ops.title: vcs: warn or disable rerere during ccx replays
ops.description: Seen on the rv-spend-ddog lane, 2026-09-25: rerere silently reused a stale resolution that dropped the branch's own hunks in shadow.ts. When a ccx conflict flow (stack rebase workspace, replay conflicts) resolves with rerere, it gives no sign. stack rebase's conflict workspace already sets rerere off; check every other path where ccx replays or rebases.

ops.text: Any ccx rebase/replay path either runs with rerere.enabled=false or reports each path rerere resolved
A test in which a recorded rerere preimage exists fails before the change
